name: Electric Bicycle
description: A bicycle with fully operable pedals, a saddle or seat and an electric motor of 750 watts or less, in one of three classes: class 1 pedal assist and class 2 throttle, both to 20 mph, and class 3 pedal assist to 28 mph.

restrictions.rule: Fully operable pedals, a saddle or seat, and a motor of 750 watts or less (North Dakota Century Code §39-01-01)
Class 1 and class 3 assist only while the rider is pedaling, stopping at 20 and 28 mph; class 2 can propel it without pedaling, up to 20 mph (North Dakota Century Code §39-01-01)
The motor must disengage when the rider stops pedaling or applies the brakes (North Dakota Century Code §39-10.1-09)
Class 3 must have a functioning speedometer (North Dakota Century Code §39-10.1-09)
Carries a permanent label stating its class, top assisted speed and motor wattage (North Dakota Century Code §39-10.1-09)
Must not be tampered with to change its motor-powered speed or engagement unless the label is replaced to match (North Dakota Century Code §39-10.1-09)
Meets the CPSC's bicycle requirements (16 CFR part 1512) (North Dakota Century Code §39-10.1-09)
Riders under 18 must wear a helmet on a class 3 (North Dakota Century Code §39-10.1-09)
Counts as a bicycle under the traffic laws (North Dakota Century Code §39-01-01)
May be ridden on any bicycle or multi-use path unless the governmental entity in charge bans it (North Dakota Century Code §39-10.1-09)
Not a motor vehicle, motorcycle or motorized bicycle: no title, registration or driver's license (North Dakota Century Code §39-01-01)
Traffic violations on one put no points on the rider's driving record
